title: Quotient compatibility of inverse normalized orientation
statement: Let ell be prime, X,Y Noetherian schemes, f:X->Y smooth of relative dimension d, separated, quasi-compact, locally of finite type and compactifiable. Suppose ell is invertible at every stalk of Y and r>=m>=1. Let a,b be normalized finite smooth levels at r,m [def-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-data], and e a generator-normalized CoefficientLineComparison for the quotient [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows]. Ordinary scalar extension of a.alpha.inv followed by the actual dualizingScalarMap equals e.tensorPower(d).hom followed by b.alpha.inv. Only this coefficient-unit orientation equation is asserted, with no general-complex or pro-etale conclusion.

source.place: Quotient compatibility of inverse normalized orientation; the two-level argument.

proof.text: Primality gives positivity of ell^r and ell^m; m<=r gives divisibility. Germwise invertibility of ell gives global invertibility on Y and hence of ell^r. The two levels supply invertibility of their exponents on X. Their Geometry witnesses are propositions and hence proof irrelevant. Apply normalizedOrientation_scalar to the quotient, the two actual normalized orientations, and the supplied generator-normalized line comparison. This gives exactly the displayed equation, including equal levels and relative dimension zero.

proof_origin.place: K2: specialize the already proved normalizedOrientation_scalar theorem; Geometry witnesses are proof irrelevant.

lean.statement:
theorem quotientInverseOrientation
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (ell : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (r m : ℕ) (_hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmr : m ≤ r)
    (a : Level ell r f d) (b : Level ell m f d)
    (e : CoefficientLineComparison (FiniteReduction.quotient ell hmr)
      (ell ^ r) (ell ^ m) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) X) :
    (ordinaryScalar (FiniteReduction.quotient ell hmr) X).map a.alpha.inv ≫
        ExceptionalCoefficients.dualizingScalarMap (FiniteReduction.quotient ell hmr) f =
      (e.tensorPower d).hom ≫ b.alpha.inv
